info.title: Tamperbox API
info.description: Remote calls send inputs to our server. Artifact transforms run without target network access; diagnostic operations inspect public DNS, websites, registries or bounded network probes. Use browser-local tools for sensitive local inputs. Outputs are observations, not guarantees of trust, security or reachability.

get.description: Find available operations by task keywords or artifact media type. Send task descriptions rather than private inputs. Includes input and output contracts for planning calls.

schema.description: Task keywords only; do not include tokens or tool inputs.

200.description: Declared result; inspect warnings and partial or unavailable evidence before drawing conclusions.

post.description: Run up to twenty pure artifact transforms in order. Network diagnostic operations are not pipeline steps; combine those using agent code and explicit request calls.

post.description: Report invisible, direction, control, look-alike and decomposed characters in text with code point and position, and its length in characters, UTF-16 units, UTF-8 bytes and visible characters.
